title: Contributing Datasets
text: primary purpose datasets package exemplify epidemic nowcasting procedures. maintain consistency, please adhere following rules contributing datasets: Documentation: datasets must fully documented using roxygen2. documentation block include: Clear, English descriptions every column epidemiological interpretation (e.g., distinguishing symptom onset date report date). @format tag identifying data.frame, data.table, another format. @source tag containing URL direct origin data. @references tag associated academic papers. Provenance: data cleaned formatted, formatting script submitted data-raw/ folder. can set easily using Attribution Licensing: data originates another R package, must verify license permits redistribution. original authors listed contributors ("ctb") DESCRIPTION file. Naming Conventions & Data Types: Dataset names column names must written snake_case. Time-based columns must class Date. Avoid character strings, factors, POSIXct classes (unless intraday timestamps important dataset’s purpose). Dates follow ISO8601 standards represented YYYY-MM-DD. Saving Data: Datasets added compressed .rda files data/ folder. strongly recommend using usethis package : Framework Agnosticism: Data formats nowcast-framework specific. ensure maximum compatibility across R ecosystem, always prefer standard data.frame data.table formats specialized classes like enw_preprocess_data tbl.now. Alternative Formats: forms data, raw .csv text files, placed inst/extdata directory. Contributions type need discussed maintainers case--case basis merging. Real vs. Synthetic Data: Real-world data preferred. However, dataset contains simulated data, must clearly state title description roxygen2 block. possible, script used simulate data-generating process must included data-raw/.
